packet.headline_seed: In court as Matthew Perry's assistant sentenced
packet.description_seed: The live-in personal assistant to the actor has been sentenced to 41 months in prison, capping a multi-year legal saga surrounding the actor's death. ​​

what: In court as Matthew Perry's assistant sentenced

clean_source_blocks.text: Matthew Perry’s live-in personal assistant, who had a central role in the “Friends” star’s descent into ketamine addiction and injected him with the fatal dose of the drug, was sentenced Wednesday to three years and five months in prison. Judge Sherilyn Peace Garnett handed down the sentence to 60-year-old Kenneth Iwamasa in federal court in Los Angeles. He was also sentenced to two years of probation and a $10,000 fine. It was the fifth and final sentencing in the 2 1/2-year investigation and prosecution that followed Perry’s death at age 54 on Oct. 28, 2023. RELATED STORY | Drug counselor who gave Matthew Perry fatal ketamine gets 2 years in prison

LOS ANGELES (AP) — Matthew Perry’s live-in personal assistant, who had a central role in the “Friends” star’s descent into ketamine addiction and injected him with the fatal dose of the drug, was sentenced Wednesday to three years and five months in prison. Judge Sherilyn Peace Garnett handed down the sentence to 60-year-old Kenneth Iwamasa in federal court in Los Angeles. He was also sentenced to two years of probation and a $10,000 fine. It was the fifth and final sentencing in the 2 1/2-year investigation and prosecution that followed Perry’s death at age 54 on Oct. 28, 2023.

LOS ANGELES (AP) — The final sentencing in the 2 1/2-year investigation and prosecution following the drug death of Matthew Perry will be of the personal assistant who sat at the center of the entire affair, buying the ketamine that would cause the death of the “Friends” star and injecting him with the lethal dose. Kenneth Iwamasa, 60, is set to be sentenced Wednesday in the Los Angeles federal courtroom of Judge Sherilyn Peace Garnett, who has sentenced four of his co-defendants in the past year. The hearing began with family members of both Perry and Iwamasa in court. He was the first of them to reach a deal with prosecutors, pleading guilty in August 2024 to one count of conspiracy to distribute ketamine resulting in death. Wednesday will be his first court appearance since the case became public knowledge.

The final person charged in Matthew Perry's 2023 death has been sentenced. Kenneth Iwamasa was sentenced to three years and five months behind bars by U.S. District Judge Sherilyn Peace Garnett, marking the end of the criminal proceedings against five people over their involvement in the "Friends" star's overdose death. On Oct. 28, 2023, Perry was found dead in a jacuzzi at his Los Angeles home following a decades-long battle with substance abuse. His autopsy report ruled his death an accident caused by "the acute effects of ketamine, with contributing factors listed as drowning, coronary artery disease and the effects of buprenorphine.

LOS ANGELES (AP) — Matthew Perry’s live-in personal assistant, who had a central role in the “Friends” star’s descent into ketamine addiction and injected him with the fatal dose of the drug, was sentenced Wednesday to three years and five months in prison.

Judge Sherilyn Peace Garnett handed down the sentence to 60-year-old Kenneth Iwamasa in federal court in Los Angeles. He was also sentenced to two years of probation and a $10,000 fine.

It was the fifth and final sentencing in the 2 1/2-year investigation and prosecution that followed Perry’s death at age 54 on Oct. 28, 2023.

Iwamasa was at Perry’s side through the final days of his life, acting as the actor’s enabler, drug messenger and de facto doctor. He was the last person to see Perry alive, and he was the one who found him dead in his Jacuzzi.

He was the first person to reach a deal with prosecutors, pleading guilty in August of 2024 to one count of conspiracy to distribute ketamine resulting in death, and became their most important witness.

Iwamasa’s lawyers said in a court filing that he was an employee doing his employer’s bidding and had a “particular vulnerability” in his relationship to Perry. “In short, he could not ‘simply say no.’ That inability had tragic consequences.”

payload.title: Matthew Perryn avustajalle yli kolmen vuoden vankeustuomio
payload.summary: Näyttelijä Matthew Perryn luona asunut henkilökohtainen avustaja Kenneth Iwamasa on tuomittu Los Angelesissa kolmen vuoden ja viiden kuukauden vankeuteen Perryn kuolemaan liittyneessä huumejutussa.
payload.content:
Matthew Perryn luona asunut henkilökohtainen avustaja Kenneth Iwamasa, 60, on tuomittu Los Angelesin liittovaltion oikeudessa kolmen vuoden ja viiden kuukauden vankeuteen. Tuomio liittyy ketamiiniin, joka johti Frendit-sarjasta tunnetun Perryn kuolemaan lokakuussa 2023, ja se päättää viiteen syytettyyn kohdistuneen rikosprosessin.

## Avustaja sai vankeutta, koeaikaa ja sakot

Yhdysvaltalainen piirituomari Sherilyn Peace Garnett määräsi Iwamasalle 41 kuukauden vankeusrangaistuksen. Lisäksi hänet tuomittiin kahden vuoden koeaikaan ja 10 000 dollarin sakkoon. Kyse oli viidennestä ja viimeisestä tuomiosta tutkinnassa ja syyteprosessissa, joka käynnistyi Perryn kuoleman jälkeen.

Iwamasa oli Perryn henkilökohtainen avustaja ja asui näyttelijän luona. Oikeudessa käsiteltyjen tietojen mukaan hänellä oli keskeinen rooli tapahtumaketjussa, jossa Perry sai ketamiinia. Lähdeaineiston mukaan Iwamasa hankki ketamiinia ja pisti Perrylle kohtalokkaaksi osoittautuneen annoksen.

Iwamasa oli ensimmäinen syytetyistä, joka teki sopimuksen syyttäjien kanssa. Hän myönsi elokuussa 2024 syyllisyytensä yhteen syytekohtaan, joka koski salaliittoa ketamiinin levittämiseksi siten, että seurauksena oli kuolema. Oikeuden istunnossa oli paikalla sekä Perryn että Iwamasan perheenjäseniä.

## Matthew Perry kuoli vuonna 2023

Matthew Perry löydettiin kuolleena Los Angelesin-kotinsa porealtaasta 28. lokakuuta 2023. Hän oli 54-vuotias. Ruumiinavausraportin mukaan kuolema katsottiin tapaturmaksi, jonka aiheuttivat ketamiinin akuutit vaikutukset. Myötävaikuttaviksi tekijöiksi mainittiin hukkuminen, sepelvaltimotauti ja buprenorfiinin vaikutukset.

Perryn kuolemaa seurannut tutkinta ja oikeusprosessi kesti noin kaksi ja puoli vuotta. Neljä muuta vastaajaa oli tuomittu aiemmin saman tuomarin käsittelyissä, ja Iwamasan tuomio päätti rikosoikeudelliset menettelyt viittä henkilöä vastaan.

## Prosessi keskittyi ketamiinin toimittamiseen

Perryn tapaus on saanut laajaa huomiota, koska näyttelijä oli kertonut julkisesti pitkästä kamppailustaan päihdeongelmien kanssa. Oikeusprosessi keskittyi kuitenkin siihen, miten ketamiinia hankittiin ja toimitettiin Perrylle ennen hänen kuolemaansa sekä ketkä olivat tästä rikosoikeudellisessa vastuussa.
summary_bullets: Kenneth Iwamasa tuomittiin kolmen vuoden ja viiden kuukauden vankeuteen Los Angelesissa.
Tuomio liittyy Matthew Perryn kuolemaan lokakuussa 2023 ja ketamiinin toimittamiseen.
Kyseessä oli viimeinen tuomio viiden syytetyn rikosprosessissa.

LOS ANGELES (AP) — Matthew Perry’s live-in personal assistant, who had a central role in the “Friends” star’s descent into ketamine addiction and injected him with the fatal dose of the drug, was sentenced Wednesday to three years and five months in prison. Judge Sherilyn Peace Garnett handed down the sentence to 60-year-old Kenneth Iwamasa in federal court in Los Angeles. He was also sentenced to two years of probation and a $10,000 fine. It was the fifth and final sentencing in the 2 1/2-year investigation and prosecution that followed Perry’s death at age 54 on Oct. 28, 2023.

LOS ANGELES (AP) — The final sentencing in the 2 1/2-year investigation and prosecution following the drug death of Matthew Perry will be of the personal assistant who sat at the center of the entire affair, buying the ketamine that would cause the death of the “Friends” star and injecting him with the lethal dose. Kenneth Iwamasa, 60, is set to be sentenced Wednesday in the Los Angeles federal courtroom of Judge Sherilyn Peace Garnett, who has sentenced four of his co-defendants in the past year. The hearing began with family members of both Perry and Iwamasa in court. He was the first of them to reach a deal with prosecutors, pleading guilty in August 2024 to one count of conspiracy to distribute ketamine resulting in death. Wednesday will be his first court appearance since the case became public knowledge.

The final person charged in Matthew Perry's 2023 death has been sentenced. Kenneth Iwamasa was sentenced to three years and five months behind bars by U.S. District Judge Sherilyn Peace Garnett, marking the end of the criminal proceedings against five people over their involvement in the "Friends" star's overdose death. On Oct. 28, 2023, Perry was found dead in a jacuzzi at his Los Angeles home following a decades-long battle with substance abuse. His autopsy report ruled his death an accident caused by "the acute effects of ketamine, with contributing factors listed as drowning, coronary artery disease and the effects of buprenorphine.
